name: Petal-strewn shedding briar 010
glow_concept: thorn tips sparking with points of light
prompt: a dense sprawling bramble thicket of dark green leaves and thick arcing thorny stems, a low lush leafy mass hugging the ground with wild roses scattered through it, petal-strewn shedding briar, roughly six feet tall, human height, self-emissive at night, softly radiating light: thorn tips sparking with points of light

placement.note: Render the sprite scaled so its height == world_px_height; a character is character_height_px tall.

motion.description: This is the same picture in every frame. ONLY the small white sparks brighten a little and return, one after another. It is lit and clearly visible in every frame, including the first. It gets only SLIGHTLY brighter -- never white, never washed out -- and keeps its own colour throughout: brightest in the middle, back to its first-frame brightness at the end, never dimmer at the end than the start. The things carrying it keep exactly the shape, size, position and number they have in the first frame. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour, no outline redrawn. The last frame matches the first exactly.
